The complete workflow

One chain. Ten connected phases.

Each phase hands clean, verified material to the next—creative direction first, production engineering second, asset assembly last.

Phase 01

Niche research

Study hooks, title patterns, thumbnails, and audience signals.

Phase 02

25 titles

Push past obvious ideas and build a varied concept pool.

Phase 03

Pick the winner

Score the strongest curiosity gap and emotional promise.

Phase 04

Story outline

Plan 15 parts around one central, delayed mystery.

Phase 05

Characters

Lock C01–C10 names, faces, roles, and wardrobes.

Phase 06

Full story

Write a hook-first, twist-loaded narrative of about 7,500 words.

Phase 07

300 scenes

Split the story into continuous, production-sized moments.

Phase 08

JSON prompts

Add visual direction, dialogue, camera, wardrobe, and audio.

Phase 09

Headshots

Create ten character references for consistency tools.

Phase 10

Production pack

Assemble titles, overview, prompts, and publishing extras.

Frequently asked questions

Before you buy.

Straight answers about the format, tools, output, and purchase.

What exactly do I receive?

You receive the 50-page English-language PDF ebook. Inside the book, you will find links to the official FateHush Master Prompt document, plus the complete ten-phase workflow, troubleshooting guidance, and a seven-day launch plan.

Can I use the Master Prompt in any AI chatbot?

You can paste it into a capable AI chatbot, but model quality matters. Long stories, exact scene counts, structured JSON, and character continuity can overwhelm weak or heavily limited models. The book explains what to look for and how to check the output.

Does the ebook generate videos for me?

No. It teaches the production system and gives you the prompt framework. You will still need an AI image generator, an AI video tool with character-reference support, a basic editor, and a YouTube channel.

Is this only for African billionaire drama?

The included workflow is designed around grounded African billionaire-drama storytelling. Its production principles may inspire other formats, but the examples, title rules, character system, and creative laws are tailored to this niche.

Does this guarantee views or income?

No. Results depend on your creative decisions, consistency, execution, niche competition, and platform algorithms. The book provides a production process—not a promise of monetization.

Where do I buy the ebook?

Click any Buy button on this page. You will be taken to the official Gumroad product page, where Gumroad handles the checkout and digital delivery.

Can I share or resell the book and Master Prompt?

No. The purchase is licensed for the original buyer's personal use. The ebook and linked Master Prompt may not be resold, redistributed, shared, or republished without written permission.
